predictions.rationale: Central graph model specific to use-case diagrams; maintains actors, use cases, and their relationships.
Main class representing a Use-Case diagram within the UI; ties together model, renderer and figs.
Renderer that creates the visual figures (actors, use cases, associations) for use-case diagrams.
Figure class drawing a single Use Case node; core visual element of a use-case diagram.
Figure class drawing an Actor node; complements FigUseCase in the diagram.
Visual representation of «extend» relationships unique to use-case diagrams.
Figure for «include» relationships between use cases; specific to use-case diagrams.
UI action that allows users to create new Use Case elements on the diagram.
UI action enabling creation of Actor elements; directly supports use-case diagram editing.
Model-level helper offering operations on use-case constructs; underpins diagram elements’ semantics.
